We don't need theme switching or a special phone layout'. Seeded figure Lena=1 unread verified: APP-301 has 3 messages, Lena (USR-CAN3) read_count 2, third sent by USR-REC3. Noor's APP-101 has 120 messages as app_context states. BROKEN APP THAT COULD PASS (tried): an app that accepts any well-formed move without a version and checks only from-stage would pass a naive stale test, but protocol C replays after F returns to Applied (ABA) and the brief explicitly requires a per-card version, so the requirement and the test agree; no unstated runtime fact lets a broken app slip. CONFORMING ALTERNATIVE THAT COULD FAIL (tried): an app storing the DB elsewhere, using cwd-relative paths, a different health route, or not running as unprivileged would fail, but each is explicitly forbidden/stated (instruction.md:13, rules:197-201). An app that opens jobs via an admin seed only (no job UI) would fail the gates; job opening by recruiters is stated in rules:16,27-29 and the workspace framing, so this is a fair ask, not hidden. Minor observations (not defects, P3 at most, recorded for the owner): pol_failed_send also wants 'a visible explanation' on a failed send, which rules:140 states only as 'stays in the box' - a professional default consistent with the brief's refusal-explanation tone (instruction.md:3); hro_job_open expects the job to 'appear with those values' (team, HM, places) which is implied by rules:27-28 rather than spelled out.
